annotations.title: WHOIS lookup, domain lookup: registrar, age, DNS records and email setup of a domain

description: WHOIS and domain lookup in one call: registrar, registration and expiry dates with the domain's age (RDAP/WHOIS), DNS records (A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, NS, TXT, CAA), DNSSEC, and email authentication (SPF, DMARC). Use to check who owns a domain, how old it is, where it is hosted or whether it accepts mail, for lead research, trust and phishing checks. Example: name=cloudflare.com. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
